Research on the construction of text classification model based on deep neural network
This paper presents a novel text categorization model that integrates multi-channel feature extraction and attention mechanisms. The architecture combines convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and bidirectional LSTM (Bi-LSTM) in a parallel structure to effectively capture both local n-gram patterns and global contextual dependencies. Pre-trained word embeddings are employed in the embedding layer to initialize semantic representations, which are further refined through a self-attention mechanism
